purpose: Teach: 別段/係り/入れ替わり/直轄/年俸/引上げ/支配人/バランスシート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、別段の論文構成にこだわるな
lines.en: Ren — don't get caught up in how the paper's structured.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Light pause before the name. Casual authority — this is advice, not rebuke. Lean back slightly, as if settling into mentorship. Warm underneath the instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の受付係りを担当しました
lines.en: Yes. I handled the conference reception desk.
lines.style: Straightforward, eager to report. Quick clip on the affirmation. Slightly rushed — wants to demonstrate he's already acting on what he hears. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究者の入れ替わりに備えろ
lines.en: Ren — prepare for turnover with your collaborators.
lines.style: Same measured tone as the first instruction. Decisive. The name carries weight — this is specific guidance aimed at him. No room for interpretation, but delivered without sharpness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。直轄の研究室で実験を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move the experiments forward in the main lab.
lines.style: Respectful, confirming. Controlled pace. He's absorbing the instruction and already translating it into action in his head. Slight formality because he's speaking to his senior, but genuine willingness underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、若手研究者の年俸交渉を支援しろ
lines.en: Ren — support the salary negotiations for the junior researchers.
lines.style: Steady, authoritative without harshness. Pause before the name. This is a larger responsibility being handed over. Expect competence. The tone says: you can do this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の引上げを学長に申請しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already submitted a request to the dean to increase the research budget.
lines.style: Quiet pride in competence. Quick, assured. He's already anticipating what this instruction requires and showing he's a step ahead. Not boastful — matter-of-fact efficiency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究所の支配人とも連携しろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate with the research facility manager too.
lines.style: Same steady authority as the previous directives. This one extends the responsibility outward. The name draws focus. Expectation of competence carries forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究のバランスシート的な収支表を作りました
lines.en: Yes. I've created a balance sheet to track the research finances and outcomes.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly more relaxed than before. Shows sophistication in understanding what 'coordination' requires. Settling into confidence. Subtle exhale of completion in the trailing tone.
